title: LED head missing
fullDescription:
OKI Error 100 indicates the printer cannot detect an LED print head in one of the color positions. OKI printers use LED arrays instead of lasers; the ID signal from the head is absent.

Causes include unseated LED head after a drum swap, a broken FFC cable, or a failed head.

Open the top cover and confirm each LED head is properly seated against its drum.

causes.cause: LED head unseated after drum replacement

fixSteps.title: Reseat LED heads
fixSteps.instruction: Open top cover and gently press each LED head down until it clicks into position.

fixSteps.title: Check cable
fixSteps.instruction: Technician inspects FFC cable and replaces if damaged.

whenToCallPro: If reseating does not clear the code.

faq.a: An array of LEDs that exposes the drum, replacing a laser scanner.

title: LED head data error
shortDescription: LED head reports invalid serial data.
fullDescription:
Error 104 arises when the LED head's serial EEPROM returns invalid data. OKI uses this to validate head-drum matching.

The head or its memory chip is faulty; replacement is the typical remedy.

A firmware update occasionally resolves marginal cases.
whenToCallPro: If firmware update does not resolve.

faq.q: Does this mean the drum is bad?
faq.a: No, drum and head are separate parts.

title: LED head thermal error
fullDescription:
Error 123 indicates an LED head is above safe operating temperature. High ambient temperature or a failed internal thermistor on the head triggers the code.

Let the printer cool down for 15 minutes. If it recurs quickly the head is faulty.

Ensure adequate airflow around the printer.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off the printer for 15 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Replace head
fixSteps.instruction: Technician installs replacement LED head if recurring.

whenToCallPro: If recurring within minutes of cool-down.

faq.a: Close to the limit — OKI rates 10-32C.

title: Fuser unit missing
fullDescription:
OKI Error 170 indicates the fuser unit is missing or improperly seated. The printer cannot heat paper without a fuser and refuses to proceed.

After a paper jam clear, the fuser locking levers might not be fully re-engaged. Reseat and verify the levers click into place.

Replacing a worn fuser (200k+ page life) may also be required.

fixSteps.title: Reseat fuser
fixSteps.instruction: Open rear door, release levers, remove and reinstall fuser.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuser
fixSteps.instruction: If worn, install new OKI fuser.

whenToCallPro: Not usually necessary.

faq.q: How do I know if fuser is worn?
faq.a: OKI displays 'fuser life warning' before Error 170 typically.

title: Fuser temperature error
fullDescription:
Error 171 signals that the fuser temperature is outside normal operating range — either too hot or too cold. OKI fuser units include thermistors that report temperature to the main board.

Most commonly the fuser lamp has failed, leading to cold readings.

Fuser replacement is the typical fix.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuser
fixSteps.instruction: Install OKI fuser kit for your model.

whenToCallPro: If fuser replacement does not clear.

title: Fuser overheat shutdown
fullDescription:
Error 176 is a fuser safety shutdown. The thermistor read a temperature above the safety limit and the printer disabled the fuser.

Repeated occurrences indicate a triac or thermistor fault. Do not force-reset; a runaway lamp can cause fire.

Technician intervention is required.

fixSteps.title: Power off immediately
fixSteps.instruction: Do not continue using until checked.

fixSteps.title: Technician diagnosis
fixSteps.instruction: Measure triac and thermistor, replace as needed.

whenToCallPro: Always.

faq.a: Yes — do not operate until fixed.

title: Belt unit missing
fullDescription:
Error 230 indicates the transfer belt unit is not installed or not recognized. OKI color printers use a long transfer belt under the drums.

Check it is clicked in on both sides after a replacement or jam clear.

At end-of-life replace with a fresh OKI belt unit.

fixSteps.title: Reseat belt
fixSteps.instruction: Remove belt unit and reinstall, ensuring both locking levers engage.

whenToCallPro: Not usually.

faq.q: How do I know belt life?
faq.a: OKI status menu shows belt counter.

title: Drum unit missing
shortDescription: Image drum not detected for one color.
fullDescription:
Error 240 shows a missing or unrecognized drum. OKI drums carry a smart chip identifying color, region, and life counter.

Reseat the drum if recently changed, or replace the chip/drum if end-of-life.

Aftermarket drums without correct chips also trigger this code.

fixSteps.title: Reseat drum
fixSteps.instruction: Press drum firmly into place until lever clicks.

fixSteps.title: Use genuine drum
fixSteps.instruction: Install OKI OEM drum for your region.

whenToCallPro: Rarely.

faq.a: No, drum and toner are separate on OKI.

title: Paper jam at registration
shortDescription: Paper did not reach registration sensor in time.
fullDescription:
Error 310 indicates a paper jam at the registration area. The paper did not trigger the registration sensor after being picked up, or stayed past its allotted time.

Open the feed door and remove any trapped sheet. Worn pickup rollers increase the frequency.

Replace rollers at recommended intervals.

fixSteps.title: Clear jam
fixSteps.instruction: Open doors and remove paper in the direction of travel.

fixSteps.title: Clean/replace rollers
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe rollers with isopropyl alcohol or replace if glossy.

whenToCallPro: If jams persist after cleaning rollers.

faq.a: Use 80gsm copier paper for lowest jam rate.

title: Paper jam at exit
shortDescription: Paper did not leave exit sensor in time.
fullDescription:
Error 372 is logged when a sheet stays past the exit sensor for too long or never reaches it. Often caused by curled paper snagging on the exit tray, or a faulty exit sensor.

Remove paper gently from the top tray area.

If paper repeatedly curls, check humidity and paper weight settings.

fixSteps.title: Adjust paper setting
fixSteps.instruction: Set paper weight to match loaded media in menu.

whenToCallPro: If sensor replacement is required.

faq.a: Yes, high humidity makes paper curl.

title: Duplex paper jam
fullDescription:
Error 380 indicates a jam in the duplex paper path. Paper failed to complete the flip-over cycle inside the duplex unit.

Open the rear door or duplex cover and remove any trapped paper.

Heavy stock (>120gsm) often causes duplex jams; switch to one-sided printing for those jobs.

fixSteps.title: Open rear
fixSteps.instruction: Open rear duplex cover and withdraw jam.

fixSteps.title: Use single-sided
fixSteps.instruction: For heavy stock set driver to simplex.

whenToCallPro: Only if mechanical damage is suspected.

faq.a: Not reliably on most small OKI models.

title: Multi-purpose tray feed error
fullDescription:
Error 390 is logged when the multi-purpose (manual) tray fails to feed a sheet. Stack size exceeded, wrong guides, or worn MP tray roller are common causes.

Reduce stack to within marked limit and verify the guides hug the paper.

If the MP tray pickup roller is glossy, replace it.

fixSteps.title: Reduce stack
fixSteps.instruction: Keep stack below max line; flex paper before loading.

fixSteps.title: Clean roller
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the MP pickup roller with alcohol.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning fails.

faq.a: Yes, use MP tray and envelope guide setting.

title: Paper Size Error
shortDescription: Loaded paper size does not match the tray setting.
fullDescription: OKI error 040: Loaded paper size does not match the tray setting. Verify tray settings, clear any jammed media, and replace consumables when prompted.

fixSteps.title: Check paper
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm media size, fan the stack, and reload squarely against guides.

fixSteps.title: Clear jam
fixSteps.instruction: Open the top and rear covers and remove all jammed sheets.

fixSteps.title: Update tray settings
fixSteps.instruction: Set the tray paper size in the on-panel menu to match the loaded paper.

fixSteps.title: Replace consumable
fixSteps.instruction: If 928 (fuser life) is shown, install a new fuser unit and reset the counter.

whenToCallPro: Call service if jam codes (380/390) repeat after roller cleaning, or for any unexpected fuser failure.

faq.q: How do I reset the fuser counter?
faq.a: Use the maintenance menu on the operator panel after installing the new fuser.
Usually worn pickup rollers or static between sheets — fan the stack and replace rollers.

title: Engine Communication Error (Variant)
fullDescription: Error 040 on OKI devices indicates the controller has lost link with the engine. Usually a loose cable or transient firmware issue.
whenToCallPro: Persistent error: board service.

title: Engine ID Mismatch
shortDescription: Engine board ID does not match controller.
fullDescription: Error 041 occurs when controller-engine pairing breaks, often after a board swap.
whenToCallPro: Pairing is service-grade.

title: Engine NVRAM Error
fullDescription: Error 042 indicates the engine NVRAM cannot be read. Power cycling may clear; persistent means hardware issue.
whenToCallPro: Persistent: service.

title: Tray 1 Lift Error
fullDescription: Error 048 indicates the Tray 1 elevator did not lift paper to feed level.
whenToCallPro: Motor service: tech.

title: Paper Size Mismatch
shortDescription: Paper size in tray differs from job.
fullDescription: Error 049 reports a tray paper size mismatch with the print job request.
whenToCallPro: User-fix only.

faq.a: Many OKI trays auto-sense; verify settings.

title: Fuser Warm-up Failure
fullDescription: Error 050 indicates fuser warm-up timeout — often low voltage or failed thermistor.
whenToCallPro: Fuser high-voltage: tech.

title: Fuser Overheat
fullDescription: Error 051 reports fuser overheat — stuck thermistor or LVPS short.
whenToCallPro: Fire risk — service immediately.

title: Paper Jam at Feeder
fullDescription: Error 380 indicates a paper jam at the feeder input. Usually worn pickup or wrong media.
whenToCallPro: Persistent: clutch service.

title: Image Drum Lifecycle End
shortDescription: Image drum at end of life.
fullDescription: Error 928 indicates the drum unit needs replacement.
whenToCallPro: User-replaceable.

title: Cover Open
fullDescription: Error 910 indicates the top cover or front cover is not fully closed.

fixSteps.title: Service Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If cover closed but error remains, sensor service.

whenToCallPro: Sensor work: tech.

faq.a: Misaligned toner can hold cover ajar.

title: Paper Jam at Tray
fullDescription: OKI 380 indicates paper stuck at tray feed.
whenToCallPro: Recurring.

title: Paper Jam Inside
fullDescription: 381 indicates paper trapped in main paper path.

fixSteps.title: Open Top Cover
fixSteps.instruction: Lift cover and remove drum/toner to access.

whenToCallPro: Recurring.

faq.question: Drum damage?
faq.answer: Be careful not to scratch drum surface.
